dlg.ren.prologue.n1: Welcome, Guest. Your old world has let you go.
dlg.ren.prologue.n2: You were never late, Ren Takahashi. Not once. I checked.
dlg.ren.prologue.r1: That was quick. Most people ask about the truck.
dlg.ren.prologue.r2: Let's say the truck played a part.
dlg.ren.prologue.n3: You will see numbers over what wants to hurt you. Read them. Verdalis begins in a meadow, like most good things.
dlg.sakura.prologue.n1: Welcome, Guest. Your machine says thank you, by the way.
dlg.sakura.prologue.n2: You opened a door in the air three minutes before your doctorate, Sakura Mori. I admire the timing.
dlg.sakura.prologue.c1: Can I at least publish this?
dlg.sakura.prologue.r1: There are no journals here. There are taverns. It is nearly the same thing.
dlg.sakura.prologue.r2: They were. That is exactly the problem.
dlg.sakura.prologue.n3: Here your numbers come out as light. Aim them away from the villagers. An owl called Newton will keep you company.
dlg.daichi.prologue.n1: Welcome, Guest. Sit, if you can. You have earned it.
dlg.daichi.prologue.n2: You went back in one more time, Daichi Okabe. The child on the third floor is alive.
dlg.daichi.prologue.r1: I thought you would say that.
dlg.daichi.prologue.r2: Always. That is why I chose you.
dlg.daichi.prologue.n3: This world burns now and then. You will have an axe, and a shield that does not let go. Do not carry everything alone.
dlg.haruka.prologue.n1: Welcome, Guest. The dog is fine. I thought you would want to know first.
dlg.haruka.prologue.n2: You stopped in the rain for a creature nobody owned, Haruka Aizawa. Few do.
dlg.haruka.prologue.c2: Who will look after my patients?
dlg.haruka.prologue.r1: Thank the dog. It made a good case for you.
dlg.haruka.prologue.r2: Someone kind. I saw to it.
dlg.haruka.prologue.n3: Where you are going, the creatures hurt and are too proud to say so. A small slime is already waiting for you. Be patient with it.
dlg.marco.prologue.n1: Welcome, Guest. Dinner for forty is cancelled, I am afraid.
dlg.marco.prologue.n2: A pressure cooker, Marco Ferri. You of all people.
dlg.marco.prologue.c1: It was a matter of units.
dlg.marco.prologue.c2: Did anyone at least taste the sauce?
dlg.marco.prologue.r2: The ceiling did. It had no complaints.
dlg.marco.prologue.n3: The world below has never heard of salt, soap or valves. Go gently. A crab has taken a liking to your wrench.
dlg.yuki.prologue.n1: Welcome, Guest. That was a very long jump.
dlg.yuki.prologue.n2: The painting landed well, Yuki Shirogane. You, less so.
dlg.yuki.prologue.c2: I never took anything from someone who would miss it.
dlg.yuki.prologue.r1: No catch. No locks either. You will hate it.
dlg.yuki.prologue.r2: I know. It is the only reason we are talking.
dlg.yuki.prologue.n3: You will have a pocket no one can search and a shadow with wings. Try giving something back, for once. See how it feels.
dlg.lena.prologue.n1: Welcome, Guest. You were curious about this part, I believe.
dlg.lena.prologue.n2: You have signed a great many endings, Lena Voss. This one is not yours to sign.
dlg.lena.prologue.c2: I would like to take notes.
dlg.lena.prologue.r2: You always do. I will speak slowly.
dlg.lena.prologue.n3: Below, you will see what kills before it does. And when it does anyway, you will get one more try. Use it for the living.
dlg.gideon.prologue.n1: Welcome, Guest. Yes, you. Do stop glaring.
dlg.gideon.prologue.n2: Three hundred years on a throne, Gideon Valmor, and one afternoon to lose it. I did try to be gentle.
dlg.gideon.prologue.c2: ...What do they eat, in this village?
dlg.gideon.prologue.r1: Noted. Refused. Ask again in a hundred years.
dlg.gideon.prologue.r2: Bread. Stew. They will offer you both. Say thank you.
dlg.gideon.prologue.n3: You keep the black sword and a wolf of shadow. Nobody down there has heard of you. Consider it my gift.

protagonist.ren.gift: System Eye: press Z to analyze the nearest creature: its level, health, attack, defense and what it drops. An all-rounder with a sword, a roll and a heavy strike.
protagonist.ren.story: Ren Takahashi was an office worker who had never been late once, until a truck did the arriving for him. Lyra's Threshold dropped him in a meadow in Verdalis with a practice sword and three loaves of bread, and a strange habit: he can see numbers over everything that wants to hit him. He is not sure it is a gift. He is quite sure it is better than the alternative.
protagonist.sakura.name: Sakura Mori
protagonist.sakura.tagline: A physics student whose experiment worked a little too well.
protagonist.sakura.gift: Unbound Mana: a huge pool of mana that comes back three times as fast, and spells instead of swings: her blows are magic, so intelligence and wisdom count, not strength. Fragile in a brawl; her Arcane Burst hits all around her.
protagonist.sakura.story: Sakura Mori was three minutes from a doctorate when the machine she had been warned about thanked her for her patience and opened a door in the air. The Threshold took the rest. Now she is in a world where her calculations come out as light, in the wrong direction half of the time, and every shopkeeper looks at her staff as if it were about to sneeze. She has a thesis to defend and nobody to defend it to.
protagonist.daichi.name: Daichi Okabe
protagonist.daichi.tagline: A firefighter who went back into the building one more time.
protagonist.daichi.gift: Eternal Aegis: enormous health and defense, and once every thirty seconds a blow that would kill him leaves him on his feet with one point of health. Slow, with a short rolling shield and a slam that hits half the world in front of him.
protagonist.daichi.story: Daichi Okabe heard someone call from the third floor, and the floor did not hold. He woke up with an axe in his hands and the same feeling as always: someone is in trouble and it is his turn. He does not know where he is or why, but he knows what to do with a village on fire, and in this world there seems to be one every few days.
protagonist.haruka.name: Haruka Aizawa
protagonist.haruka.tagline: A vet who stopped for a hurt dog on the road.
protagonist.haruka.gift: Universal Tamer: creatures notice her late (half the distance), and she is fast, lucky and well supplied with bread and potions (taming will come later). Light blows with her stick and a wind strike in a wide fan.
protagonist.haruka.story: Haruka Aizawa braked for a dog in the rain, and the other car did not. The Threshold dropped her somewhere with a lot of grass and a great many creatures that looked at her with a familiar expression: the one of animals that hurt and are too proud to say so. She has not understood the world yet, but she has a feeling that the slimes are less dangerous than they look and much more lonely.

protagonist.marco.gift: Modern Knowledge: everything he eats or drinks works twice as well, so bread and potions heal double (blueprints and gadgets will come with the base). A wrench for a weapon and a blast of pressure that costs 9 mana.
protagonist.marco.story: Marco Ferri had a dinner for forty and a pressure cooker with opinions. The explosion was, he insists, a matter of units. The Threshold put him in a meadow with a wrench in his pocket and the certainty that this world has never heard of salt, soap or the pressure cooker, and that he can fix that, one village at a time.
protagonist.yuki.name: Yuki Shirogane
protagonist.yuki.tagline: An art thief who made a very long jump.
protagonist.yuki.gift: Pocket Dimension: she recovers from a roll twice as fast (the infinite pocket will come later). Fast and precise but fragile: a dagger, a short shadow step that covers a lot of ground and a shadow cut that costs 8 mana.
protagonist.yuki.story: Yuki Shirogane was on a rooftop with a painting she had not paid for, a security guard below and a good reason to jump. She does not remember landing. She remembers a meadow, a village with no locks on any door, and the unpleasant feeling of being, for the first time, in a place where stealing is hard because nobody owns anything worth the trouble.

protagonist.lena.gift: Return to Death: once every forty seconds a blow that would kill her leaves her alive with one point of health, as if she had been here before. Sharp with a scalpel, and a magical autopsy strike that costs 8 mana; fragile in a long fight.
protagonist.lena.story: Lena Voss has seen a great many ways to die and was a little too curious about hers. She woke up on a meadow with the memory of the last thing she saw, the habit of noticing what kills, and a clear feeling that the world is giving her another try. She has not decided yet what to do with it. She is taking notes.
protagonist.gideon.name: Gideon Valmor
protagonist.gideon.tagline: The Demon King, reincarnated, and slightly embarrassed.
protagonist.gideon.gift: Lord of Darkness: creatures fear him and notice him only from a third of the usual distance, and he is strong and tough, but healing works on him at a little over half (the dark makes poor medicine). A black blade, and Dominion, a wide blow that costs 10 mana and hits all around him.
protagonist.gideon.story: Gideon Valmor ruled the Ashen Wastes for three hundred years and lost to a goddess called Lyra in a single afternoon. She sent him back as a Guest, in a meadow, with a black sword and a village that has never heard of him. The villagers are polite. He finds that he likes it more than he expected, which is the most alarming thing that has happened to him.

quest.act1_sakura_1.name: Stray Light
quest.act1_sakura_1.task: The mint slimes around Aldermere glow at night since Sakura arrived. Defeat eight and collect what they drop.
quest.act1_sakura_2.name: A Lens of Gel
quest.act1_sakura_2.task: Sakura needs slime gel and pine resin to build a lens that shows where the light leaks from.
quest.act1_sakura_3.name: The First Echo
quest.act1_sakura_3.task: The light leaks from Mint Hollow, south-west of Fenwick. Defeat the Mint Matron that drank it.
quest.act1_daichi_1.name: Where There Is Smoke
quest.act1_daichi_1.task: Tawny wolves are fleeing something on the hills. Drive back six of them and keep the road safe.
quest.act1_daichi_2.name: A Line in the Grass
quest.act1_daichi_2.task: Daichi wants a firebreak around Aldermere: logs and stone to hold a line.
quest.act1_daichi_3.name: The First Echo
quest.act1_daichi_3.task: The smoke rises from Grunmoor Barrow, north-west of Fenwick. Its warden burns with a fire from another world.
quest.act1_haruka_1.name: Bedside Manner
quest.act1_haruka_1.task: The green slimes near Aldermere are feverish and wild. Calm eight of them the only way they understand.
quest.act1_haruka_2.name: A Tonic for the Meadow
quest.act1_haruka_2.task: Haruka can brew a remedy for the slimes from healing herbs and wild berries.
quest.act1_haruka_3.name: The First Echo
quest.act1_haruka_3.task: The fever began with the Mint Matron of Mint Hollow, south-west of Fenwick. End her pain.
quest.act1_marco_1.name: A Matter of Units
quest.act1_marco_1.task: The myconids near Aldermere swell and burst since Marco arrived. Defeat six and gather their caps.
quest.act1_marco_2.name: A Proper Valve
quest.act1_marco_2.task: Marco will build a valve to let the pressure out: iron ore and wood for the fitting.
quest.act1_marco_3.name: The First Echo
quest.act1_marco_3.task: The pressure gathers in Mossveil Cellar, north of Fenwick. Defeat the Gel King before he bursts.
quest.act1_yuki_1.name: Light Fingers
quest.act1_yuki_1.task: Things vanish from Aldermere and turn up on tawny wolves. Take back what six of them carry.
quest.act1_yuki_2.name: Bait
quest.act1_yuki_2.task: Yuki will lay a trap for the thief: spider-fine thread is not at hand, so pine resin and dry branches will do.
quest.act1_yuki_3.name: The First Echo
quest.act1_yuki_3.task: The thief is the warden of Grunmoor Barrow, north-west of Fenwick, and it has Yuki's painting.
quest.act1_lena_1.name: Cause Unknown
quest.act1_lena_1.task: Myconids are dying around Aldermere with no wound. Examine six, in the only way they allow.
quest.act1_lena_2.name: A Second Opinion
quest.act1_lena_2.task: Lena needs mint leaves and healing herbs to test what the grey ring is.
quest.act1_lena_3.name: The First Echo
quest.act1_lena_3.task: The poison seeps from Mossveil Cellar, north of Fenwick. The Gel King carries it. End the case.
quest.act1_gideon_1.name: Loyal Subjects
quest.act1_gideon_1.task: Tawny wolves kneel when Gideon passes and then raid the farms in his name. Correct eight of them.
quest.act1_gideon_2.name: Tribute, Returned
quest.act1_gideon_2.task: Gideon will pay back what was taken in his name: furs and gel for the farms.
quest.act1_gideon_3.name: The First Echo
quest.act1_gideon_3.task: A voice from Mossveil Cellar offers Gideon his old crown. The Gel King wears it. Answer him.
talent.might.name: Might
talent.vigor.name: Vigor
talent.focus.name: Focus
talent.guard.name: Guard
item.archmage_staff.name: Archmage's staff
item.archmage_staff.desc: It hums in a key that only equations can hear.
item.coroners_blade.name: Coroner's blade
item.coroners_blade.desc: Thin, cold and very sure of itself.
quest.act2_ren_1.name: Overtime Underground
quest.act2_ren_1.task: In Ironspine, far to the north-east, the slate slimes have started working in shifts. Stop eight and bring back slate shards.
quest.act2_ren_2.name: Paperwork
quest.act2_ren_2.task: The mine's ledgers are written on rust and ore. Bring rust flakes and iron ore from Ironspine so Sister Maren can read them.
quest.act2_ren_3.name: The Second Echo
quest.act2_ren_3.task: The Iron Foreman runs Ironspine Mine like the office Ren left behind. Give him your notice.
quest.act2_sakura_1.name: Falling Stars
quest.act2_sakura_1.task: In Lumeria, far to the south, the glow slimes shine with Sakura's equations. Defeat eight and gather star dust.
quest.act2_sakura_2.name: Peer Review
quest.act2_sakura_2.task: Someone in Lumeria is correcting Sakura's work. Bring nebula ash and wisp embers to trace the hand.
quest.act2_sakura_3.name: The Second Echo
quest.act2_sakura_3.task: The Astral Curator of the Starfall Observatory has the rest of Sakura's machine and means to switch it on. Defend your thesis.
quest.act2_daichi_1.name: A Land on Fire
quest.act2_daichi_1.task: The Ashen Wastes, far to the east, burn hotter since Daichi came. Put out eight ember slimes and bring their cores.
quest.act2_daichi_2.name: Water Line
quest.act2_daichi_2.task: Daichi will cool the road to the citadel: magma shards to map the heat, stone to build a channel.
quest.act2_daichi_3.name: The Second Echo
quest.act2_daichi_3.task: The Cinder Colossus holds the Cinder Citadel and everyone in it. Go back in, one more time.
quest.act2_haruka_1.name: The Limping Pack
quest.act2_haruka_1.task: In Whisperwood, far to the west, the shade wolves are hurt and savage. Quiet eight and bring shade wisps to study.
quest.act2_haruka_2.name: Salve
quest.act2_haruka_2.task: Haruka will make a salve for the pack from moss clumps and healing herbs.
quest.act2_haruka_3.name: The Second Echo
quest.act2_haruka_3.task: The Moss Elder of the Mossy Den carries the largest shard of Haruka's accident. Free him of it.
quest.act2_marco_1.name: Catch of the Day
quest.act2_marco_1.task: In Tidehaven, far to the south-west, the shore crabs have grown armour of pot-metal. Crack eight and bring their shells.
quest.act2_marco_2.name: Salt and Pearl
quest.act2_marco_2.task: Marco will cook for the harbour to learn where the rest of his kitchen sank: tide pearls and coral fragments.
quest.act2_marco_3.name: The Second Echo
quest.act2_marco_3.task: The Drowned Captain of the Sunken Galleon has Marco's great pressure cooker, and it is still sealed. Relieve him of the kitchen.
quest.act2_yuki_1.name: A Buyer in the Desert
quest.act2_yuki_1.task: In Sunscar, far to the south-east, someone pays in amber for anything from another world. Follow the amber: eight amber slimes and their drops.
quest.act2_yuki_2.name: Tools of the Trade
quest.act2_yuki_2.task: Yuki needs to pick a lock that has no keyhole: scorpion stings for picks, dune pelts to muffle the stone.
quest.act2_yuki_3.name: The Second Echo
quest.act2_yuki_3.task: The Sand Sentinel of the Sunken Ziggurat collects what falls through the Threshold. It has Yuki's second painting.
quest.act2_lena_1.name: Cold Cases
quest.act2_lena_1.task: In Frostveil, far to the north, the dead do not stay down. Examine eight frost wolves that rose again, and bring their pelts.
quest.act2_lena_2.name: Time of Death
quest.act2_lena_2.task: Lena will fix the hour the dead began to rise, from ice crystals and owl feathers.
quest.act2_lena_3.name: The Second Echo
quest.act2_lena_3.task: The Rime Revenant of Frostveil Cavern has Lena's gift without her judgement: nothing near him stays dead. Pronounce him.
quest.act2_gideon_1.name: The Old Country
quest.act2_gideon_1.task: The Ashen Wastes, far to the east, were Gideon's kingdom. Char slimes still wear his banner. Take it from eight of them.
quest.act2_gideon_2.name: Reparations
quest.act2_gideon_2.task: Gideon will rebuild what his reign burned at Ember Watch: golem cores for the forge, ember cores for the hearths.
quest.act2_gideon_3.name: The Second Echo
quest.act2_gideon_3.task: The Char Tyrant of the Char Pit sits on what is left of Gideon's throne. Abdicate, properly this time.
quest.act3_ren_1.name: The Archive of Lost Things
quest.act3_ren_1.task: Everything the Threshold swallowed is being filed somewhere in the Ashen Wastes. Clear the way: eight dire wolves and the golem cores that guard the road.
quest.act3_ren_2.name: Index
quest.act3_ren_2.task: Sister Maren will read the archive's index from magma shards and char chunks of the Wastes.
quest.act3_ren_3.name: The Last Echo
quest.act3_ren_3.task: The Vault Warden of the Obsidian Vault keeps everything the Threshold ever took. Open the vault and let it go.
quest.act3_sakura_1.name: Storm Front
quest.act3_sakura_1.task: The sky over Lumeria tears where Sakura's door opened. Ground the storm: eight storm wolves and their feathers.
quest.act3_sakura_2.name: The Equation
quest.act3_sakura_2.task: Sakura has the equation that closes the door. She needs star dust and nebula ash to write it on the sky.
quest.act3_sakura_3.name: The Last Echo
quest.act3_sakura_3.task: The Nebula Heart of the Nebula Pool holds Sakura's door open. Close it, and keep it closed.
quest.act3_daichi_1.name: Evacuation
quest.act3_daichi_1.task: The ground of the Ashen Wastes is opening. Clear the road out of Ember Watch: eight magma slimes and their shards.
quest.act3_daichi_2.name: Breathing Gear
quest.act3_daichi_2.task: Daichi needs a mask for the vent: spider silk for the cloth and ember cores to warm the filter.
quest.act3_daichi_3.name: The Last Echo
quest.act3_daichi_3.task: The Magma Heart of the Magma Vent is the first fire, the one from the third floor, grown into the root of a land. Put it out.
quest.act3_haruka_1.name: Night Watch
quest.act3_haruka_1.task: In Whisperwood the night owls have stopped sleeping. Ease eight and gather their feathers.
quest.act3_haruka_2.name: A Collar
quest.act3_haruka_2.task: Haruka will make a collar of the forest to calm what waits in the Hollow: shade wisps and wisp embers.
quest.act3_haruka_3.name: The Last Echo
quest.act3_haruka_3.task: The Moonshade Alpha of Whisperwood Hollow is the fear of the night of Haruka's accident, grown into a beast. Bring it peace.
quest.act3_marco_1.name: Supply Chain
quest.act3_marco_1.task: The Deep Forge of Ironspine is making copies of Marco's cookware, badly. Stop the rust slimes that carry the metal: eight, and their flakes.
quest.act3_marco_2.name: Safety Standard
quest.act3_marco_2.task: Marco will write the first safety standard of Aethermoor, on slate, with valves of golem core.
quest.act3_marco_3.name: The Last Echo
quest.act3_marco_3.task: The Forge-Tyrant of the Deep Forge built himself from Marco's great pot and means to make the whole world his kitchen. Shut him down.
quest.act3_yuki_1.name: A Pearl Market
quest.act3_yuki_1.task: In Tidehaven the pearl slimes pay for stolen things in pearl dust. Follow the payment: eight pearl slimes and their dust.
quest.act3_yuki_2.name: The Last Job
quest.act3_yuki_2.task: Yuki plans one last theft: tide pearls for the guards, coral to open the shoal.
quest.act3_yuki_3.name: The Last Echo
quest.act3_yuki_3.task: The Pearl Empress of the Pearl Shoal owns the last painting Yuki took. Steal it back, and give it away.
quest.act3_lena_1.name: The Polar Silence
quest.act3_lena_1.task: In Frostveil the polar wolves have stopped making any sound at all. Examine eight, and bring their fur.
quest.act3_lena_2.name: Autopsy of a Winter
quest.act3_lena_2.task: Lena will find what killed the warmth of Frostveil: ice crystals from the slimes and bat wings from the caves.
quest.act3_lena_3.name: The Last Echo
quest.act3_lena_3.task: The Frost Sovereign of the Glacier Keep holds Frostveil in a winter that cannot end. Let it end.
quest.act3_gideon_1.name: The Old Army
quest.act3_gideon_1.task: Gideon's old army has woken in the Ashen Wastes and is marching on Ember Watch. Turn them back: eight dire wolves and their fangs.
quest.act3_gideon_2.name: A Proclamation
quest.act3_gideon_2.task: Gideon will write his last proclamation as king: that there is no king. Storm feathers to write, ember cores to seal.
quest.act3_gideon_3.name: The Last Echo
quest.act3_gideon_3.task: The Storm Sovereign of the Storm Roost was Gideon's most loyal general. He will not accept that his king is gone. Deliver the proclamation.

quest.act4_ren_1.name: The Echo Itself
quest.act4_ren_1.task: The last overtime of Ren's old life has taken a shape and waits in the Sanctum of Numbers, west of the start. Clock out.
quest.act4_sakura_1.name: The Echo Itself
quest.act4_sakura_1.task: The equation Sakura never finished has become a creature of light in the Sanctum of Light, west of the start. Finish it.
quest.act4_daichi_1.name: The Echo Itself
quest.act4_daichi_1.task: The moment the floor gave way has taken a shape of smoke and fire in the Sanctum of Embers, north of the start. Walk out.
quest.act4_haruka_1.name: The Echo Itself
quest.act4_haruka_1.task: The rain on the road where Haruka stopped has become a creature in the Sanctum of Rain, south of the start. Let it pass.
quest.act4_marco_1.name: The Echo Itself
quest.act4_marco_1.task: The pressure that blew Marco out of his world has gathered in the Sanctum of Steam, north of the start. Let it out, gently.
quest.act4_yuki_1.name: The Echo Itself
quest.act4_yuki_1.task: The jump from the rooftop, the last frame of Yuki's old life, waits in the Sanctum of Frames, south of the start. Land.
quest.act4_lena_1.name: The Echo Itself
quest.act4_lena_1.task: The report on Lena's own death was never written. It has written itself, in the Sanctum of Silence, east of the start. Sign it.
quest.act4_gideon_1.name: The Echo Itself
quest.act4_gideon_1.task: Three hundred years on a throne have left a shape behind: the throne itself, in the Sanctum of Ash, east of the start. Stand up from it.

quest.crossroads_mint.name: Mint in the Wheels
quest.crossroads_mint.task: Mint slimes clog the wheels of Pell's carts at the Crossroads Camp. Clear them out and bring some leaves.
quest.crossroads_wolves.name: Escort Duty
quest.crossroads_wolves.task: Tawny wolves follow Pell's carts out of the Crossroads. Drive them off and bring their fur.
quest.whisperwood_spores.name: Spores for Salves
quest.whisperwood_spores.task: Wren needs spore caps from the myconids of Whisperwood for her salves.
quest.whisperwood_silk.name: Silk for Bandages
quest.whisperwood_silk.task: The spiders of Whisperwood spin the best bandages in the world. Bring Wren their silk.
quest.ironspine_rust.name: Rust in the Soup
quest.ironspine_rust.task: Rust slimes have crept into the Waystation's kitchen. Clear them out of Ironspine and bring back their flakes.
quest.ironspine_golems.name: A Better Oven
quest.ironspine_golems.task: Brakka wants golem cores to build an oven that never goes out. The stone golems of Ironspine carry them.
quest.tidehaven_crabs.name: Cut Nets
quest.tidehaven_crabs.task: Shore crabs cut the nets of Brinewatch every night. Teach eight of them otherwise and bring their shells.
quest.tidehaven_coral.name: Coral Weights
quest.tidehaven_coral.task: Nella weights her best nets with coral. The coral slimes of Tidehaven carry the right kind.
quest.frostveil_ice.name: Clear Ice
quest.frostveil_ice.task: Henrik carves only the clearest ice, and the ice slimes of Frostveil hoard it. Bring him crystals.
quest.frostveil_polar.name: A Warm Coat for an Old Man
quest.frostveil_polar.task: Henrik's coat is older than he is. The polar wolves of Frostveil would make a better one.
quest.sunscar_scorpions.name: Stings in the Water
quest.sunscar_scorpions.task: Dune scorpions nest by the wells of Sunscar. Drive six away and bring Farid their stings, for the apothecary.
quest.sunscar_dunes.name: The Dune Pack
quest.sunscar_dunes.task: The dune wolves of Sunscar raid the caravans at dusk. Break the pack and bring their pelts.
quest.lumeria_glow.name: Star Dust
quest.lumeria_glow.task: Astra grinds lenses with star dust, and the glow slimes of Lumeria carry it.
quest.lumeria_storm.name: Calm Skies
quest.lumeria_storm.task: Astra cannot see the stars through the storms. The storm wolves of Lumeria feed them; ground five.
quest.ashen_embers.name: Fuel for the Forge
quest.ashen_embers.task: Grael's forge runs on ember cores, and the ember slimes of the Ashen Wastes carry them.
quest.ashen_char.name: Charcoal of the Wastes
quest.ashen_char.task: For his best steel Grael wants char from the char slimes of the Ashen Wastes.
item.fine_iron_sword.name: Fine iron sword
item.fine_iron_sword.desc: Folded twice at an anvil. It hums when it cuts.
item.fine_hand_axe.name: Fine hand axe
item.fine_hand_axe.desc: Balanced so well it seems to swing itself.
item.fine_pike.name: Fine pike
item.fine_pike.desc: A long point of anvil-hardened steel.
item.fine_leather_vest.name: Fine leather vest
item.fine_studded_leather.name: Fine studded leather
item.fine_studded_leather.desc: Every stud riveted by hand at an anvil.
item.moonmoss_draught.name: Moonmoss draught
item.moonmoss_draught.desc: Brewed in Whisperwood by moonlight. Tastes of a forest at night.
item.miners_broth.name: Miner's broth
item.miners_broth.desc: Iron in it, and something worse. It works.
item.desert_nectar.name: Desert nectar
item.desert_nectar.desc: Amber sweetness with a sting at the end.
item.frost_tonic.name: Frost tonic
item.frost_tonic.desc: So cold it clears the mind. Filtered through polar fur.
item.pearl_elixir.name: Pearl elixir
item.pearl_elixir.desc: The sea, bottled, with all its patience.
item.ember_brew.name: Ember brew
item.ember_brew.desc: Drink it fast. It is still burning.
item.starlight_elixir.name: Starlight elixir
item.starlight_elixir.desc: It glows in the bottle and, for a while, in you.
item.river_fish.name: Fresh fish
item.river_fish.desc: Still wet. Better grilled, but it will do raw. Restores a little health.
item.golden_carp.name: Golden carp
item.golden_carp.desc: A rare fish with scales like coins. Merchants pay well for it.
enemy.wild_boar.name: Wild boar
enemy.ridge_elk.name: Ridge elk
item.game_meat.name: Game meat
item.game_meat.desc: Fresh from the hunt. Better roasted, but it will do. Restores a little health.
item.boar_hide.name: Boar hide
item.boar_hide.desc: Thick and bristly. Tanners love it.
item.elk_antler.name: Elk antler
item.roast_meat.name: Roast meat
item.roast_meat.desc: Crackling outside, tender inside. Restores health.
item.hunters_stew.name: Hunter's stew
item.hunters_stew.desc: Meat, herbs and patience. Restores a lot of health.
item.hunters_jerkin.name: Hunter's jerkin
item.hunters_jerkin.desc: Boar hide over leather, with antler toggles. Light and tough.
item.antler_spear.name: Antler spear
item.antler_spear.desc: A long shaft with an elk's antler for a point. It reaches far.
quest.crossroads_matron.name: The Mother of Mint
quest.crossroads_matron.task: Every mint slime of the Crossroads comes from one place: Mint Hollow, where the Mint Matron sits. Pell asks you to end it there.
quest.whisperwood_elder.name: The Moss Elder
quest.whisperwood_elder.task: The Moss Elder of the Mossy Den makes the wood sick around Hollow's Edge. Wren asks you to put it to rest.
quest.ironspine_baron.name: The Rust Baron
quest.ironspine_baron.task: The rust slimes have a master: the Rust Baron of the Rust Pit. Brakka wants her kitchen clean for good.
quest.tidehaven_empress.name: The Pearl Empress
quest.tidehaven_empress.task: Out on the Pearl Shoal the Pearl Empress keeps the fish away from Brinewatch. Nella asks you to depose her.
quest.frostveil_king.name: The Polar King
quest.frostveil_king.task: The polar wolves follow a king, in the Polar Rookery north of Rimewatch. Henrik wants to carve him, after you are done.
quest.sunscar_mother.name: The Dune Mother
quest.sunscar_mother.task: The dune wolves come from a den south of the Caravanserai, where the Dune Mother raises them. Farid asks you to end the litter.
quest.lumeria_heart.name: The Nebula Heart
quest.lumeria_heart.task: A Nebula Heart beats in the Nebula Pool, and every beat blurs the sky of Lantern Rest. Astra asks you to still it.
quest.ashen_tyrant.name: The Char Tyrant
quest.ashen_tyrant.task: The char slimes answer to the Char Tyrant of the Char Pit. Grael asks you to bring the Wastes a little peace.
quest.fenwick_mushrooms.name: Mushrooms in the Well
quest.fenwick_mushrooms.task: Myconids have crept up to the well of Fenwick. Elder Bran asks you to drive four away and bring their caps to the healer.
quest.fenwick_mint.name: Mint for the Pastry
quest.fenwick_mint.task: Odile wants mint leaves for a new pastry. The mint slimes around Fenwick carry the freshest.
quest.fenwick_gel_king.name: The King Under the Cellar
quest.fenwick_gel_king.task: Tobin swears a king of slimes lives in the Mossveil Cellar, north of Fenwick. Go and see; if he is there, end his reign.
quest.aldermere_dire_alpha.name: The Alpha of the Dire Den
quest.aldermere_dire_alpha.task: The guild has a standing bounty on the Dire Alpha of the Dire Den, in Ironspine. Hestia thinks it is time someone collected it.
quest.aldermere_golem_cores.name: Cores for the Lanterns
quest.aldermere_golem_cores.task: Rook wants golem cores to light the guild hall through the winter. The stone golems carry them.
quest.aldermere_curator.name: The Last Page of the Observatory
quest.aldermere_curator.task: Selwyn's catalogue of the Starfall Observatory, in Lumeria, has one page missing: its Curator. Defeat it and bring him the story.
quest.tidehaven_catch.name: Fresh for the Table
quest.tidehaven_catch.task: Brinewatch has nets again, but no fishers. Nella asks you to try the reeds of the shore and bring six fresh fish.
quest.crossroads_boars.name: Boars in the Barley
quest.crossroads_boars.task: Wild boars dig up the barley by the Crossroads. Pell asks you to hunt five and bring back meat for the camp.
quest.frostveil_antlers.name: Antlers for the Chisels
quest.frostveil_antlers.task: Henrik's chisels have worn out. The ridge elks of Frostveil carry the only antler hard enough to make new handles.
quest.personal_gideon_2.task: Four tawny wolves and two furs: the village, politely, asks for a tribute.
